audit.why: Wukong 54.01% over 461 games; the lane reads EVEN-favourable. Early levels are Wukong's, level 6 flips to Galio because Hero's Entrance (180/160/140s) gives him map value the duel does not.
audit.corrected: Level chart matches the packet and the mirror audit: Wukong 1-2, Skill 3, Wukong 4-5, Galio 6, Wukong first item and 2+.

audit.why: Galio's spikes are Justice Punch rank-ups (11s down to 7s), level 6 Hero's Entrance, and MR/HP items. Wukong's are levels 2-3, Black Cleaver, and the 2-item side-lane window. Per the mirror, Warrior Trickster's 22s at rank 1 is the real clock in this lane, not the dash.
audit.corrected: Spikes text now names the 11s Justice Punch cooldown so the trade window is concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer repeatedly calls Galio's passive a shield — 'through his broken shield', 'passive-shield trades', 'while his passive shield is down'. Colossal Smash is an auto-attack reset that deals bonus MAGIC damage in an area. Galio has no passive shield; his shields come from Shield of Durand (W) and Hero's Entrance (R).
audit.why: Riot's own text for the passive: 'Every few seconds, Galio's next basic attack deals bonus magic damage in an area.' The mirror audit states the same from Galio's side.
audit.corrected: Colossal Smash is a bonus-magic-damage auto reset, not a shield. The decisive interaction is Cyclone's knockup cancelling a charging Shield of Durand outright and interrupting Hero's Entrance inside its first 1.25 seconds; Warrior Trickster's clone eats Justice Punch and leaves it down 11s at rank 1.

audit.why: Justice Punch is 11/10/9/8/7s and Shield of Durand 18/17/16/15/14s — both punishable windows, and the page already trades around Justice Punch.
audit.corrected: Added the real 11s rank-1 number where the advice is given.

audit.whatIsWrong: The pages never state that Cyclone cancels a CHARGING Shield of Durand, only that it 'interrupts his taunt channel' vaguely, and never mention the Hero's Entrance interrupt window.
audit.why: Shield of Durand is a charged release; a knockup during the charge cancels it. Hero's Entrance has a landing delay that displacement can interrupt early.
audit.corrected: Stated in spikes[2], spikes[3] and the full-layer ability box.

edits.after: You own level 1 as Nimbus Strike into Crushing Blow chunks a mana-starved Galio.

edits.before: You reclaim first-item as burst beats his shield and R interrupts his taunt channel.
edits.after: You reclaim first-item as Cyclone's knockup cancels his charging Shield of Durand.

edits.before: You out-trade Galio early: E-Q clone all-ins beat his mana-hungry Winds of War (Q) poke, and if he tries to Justice Punch (E) engage, W dodges it and leaves him on cooldown. Crushing Blow shreds his armor while his passive shield is down.
edits.after: You out-trade Galio early: E-Q all-ins beat his mana-hungry Winds of War (Q) poke, and if he Justice Punches (E) in, the Warrior Trickster clone eats it and leaves him down 11s at rank 1. Crushing Blow shreds the armour he leans on.

edits.before: You recover the edge post-item: your burst combo still beats his passive-shield trades, and R Cyclone's knockup interrupts his W channel taunt before it can peel or engage.
edits.after: You recover the edge post-item: Colossal Smash's bonus is magic damage, so your armour shred still wins, and Cyclone's knockup cancels a charging Shield of Durand outright.

edits.before: Late Galio is a utility tank, not a duelist; you win the 1v1 all game if you dodge his E and don't fight into a fresh W taunt. Save R to cancel his Durand shield.
edits.after: Late Galio is a utility tank, not a duelist; you win the 1v1 if you clone his E and never fight a fresh W. Cyclone interrupts Hero's Entrance in its first 1.25s.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are yours: Galio is squishy and mana-starved before items, so E-Q clone all-ins chunk him while his passive shield is broken. Punish any Winds of War whiff and don't let him free-poke, get in his face.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are yours: Galio is squishy and mana-starved before items, so E-Q clone all-ins chunk him — Colossal Smash is his only damage tell. Punish any Winds of War whiff and don't let him free-poke, get in his face.

edits.before: After first item you reclaim the duel: burst plus Crushing Blow beats his passive-shield trades and R Cyclone interrupts his taunt channel. By 2+ items Galio is a utility tank you out-duel all game; just respect his E engage and save R to cancel Shield of Durand.
edits.after: After first item you reclaim the duel: burst plus Crushing Blow's shred beats his trades and Cyclone's knockup cancels a charging Shield of Durand. By 2+ items Galio is a utility tank you out-duel all game; respect the 650-range Justice Punch and save R for his W.

edits.before: Track Galio's Justice Punch: His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. When it is down — E-Q shred, W out, R knockup.
edits.after: Track Justice Punch: a 650-range dash knockup, 11s at rank 1. When it is spent — E-Q shred, W out, Cyclone cancels his charging W.
